source: Lau and Shiu, On local antimagic chromatic number of the join of two special families of graphs II, arXiv:2410.17674v1; Utilitas Math. 124 (2025) 189-206, Conjecture 4.1 (retained on published p. 205)
scope: Credit, if all gates pass, for refuting Conjecture 4.1 (chi_la(2r((2s+1)P_2 join O_m)) = 3 for r, s >= 1, m >= 2) at r = s = 1, m = 2. The exact value chi_la = 4 is supporting ordinary computation unless also formalized.
literal_endpoint_requirement: the discovery packet proves an instantiated obstruction (no labelling of the fixed 16-vertex graph with at most 3 weights); the campaign requires a literal endpoint: a general SimpleGraph family G r s m for 2r((2s+1)P_2 join O_m), chi_la as the least colour count of local antimagic labellings (reuse 354228's literal Labeling/weight/IsLocal/colorCount/spectrum/chiLA definitions), Conjecture41 := forall r s m, 1 <= r -> 1 <= s -> 2 <= m -> chiLA (G r s m) = 3, and a proved bridge from G 1 1 2 to the obstruction, ending in a theorem not Conjecture41
family_ruling: distinct from the credited 354228 (different conjecture, authors, graph family and mechanism); sharing chi_la does not make it a parameter variant
significance: QUALIFIED_PASS, modest: a short complete obstruction refuting a 2025 published universal conjecture; the equal-null parity case has an older analogue (Chan-Lau-Shiu, chi_la(C_3 + C_3) = 4), but the mixed-role case is genuinely new
remaining_literature_limit: the MDPI paper 'Local Antimagic Chromatic Number for Copies of Graphs' returned 403 and is unread
